items.lede: Apple is working on a new fitness tracker with a screenless design, similar to the one made by Whoop, according to a report from Bloomberg. A prototype of the device reportedly has "a thin fabric band with a sensor-equipped computing module." The device is in an early stage of development and likely wouldn't arrive before […]
items.title: Apple is reportedly working on a Whoop-like fitness tracker

items.lede: Apple may be developing a new fitness tracker as part of its new generation of hardware devices.
